decisions.reason: It has the strongest visible commitment with its own page, and as a recently launched software offer it is worth keeping while market feedback is still forming.
As a complementary connectivity module, it likely has low carrying cost and enough strategic upside to justify keeping the option open for another year.
Although billing software is somewhat less central to an electrical equipment maker's core than operational modules, the launch is still too recent to abandon before uncertainty resolves further.
Equipment monitoring software fits closely with the firm's industrial base, so management would likely retain it as a low-cost digital extension of core offerings.
This resource management module is adjacent to the firm's apron operations portfolio and is likely inexpensive to maintain while customer adoption becomes clearer.

The safety alert service appears the riskiest because it may require more support and sits slightly farther from the firm's hardware core, but after only one year its option value still argues for retention.
